about:
CHR Metals, LLC operates from Springfield, Missouri, offering custom metal fabrication, modification, and repair services. The company's founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides a wide range of metalworking processes, including TIG and MIG welding, CNC plasma cutting, metal shearing, and bending. It fabricates structural items such as catwalks, stairs, platforms, ladders, safety cages, welded pipe and duct, and dust collection systems. Additional capabilities cover architectural sheet metal, wrought iron gates and fencing, restaurant and institutional stainless steel equipment, copper gutters and roofing, as well as metal art and custom one-of-a-kind projects. The facility also handles portable welding, trailer and equipment repair, and aluminum boat repair.

CHR Metals serves industrial, commercial, and private customers, with specific experience in restaurant and institutional stainless steel fabrication and marine-related aluminum boat repair. Clients range from local businesses needing custom handrails or guard systems to institutions requiring specialized stainless steel counters, splash guards, and wall coverings.

The company emphasizes its ability to take on unusual and one-of-a-kind private projects, positioning itself as a flexible job shop for both standard and highly customized metalwork.
